response: Yes, vertical lines in distal esophageal mucosa (VLEM) are a true endoscopic manifestation of esophagitis in children. Histology usually demonstrates moderate to severe inflammation when VLEM are present, suggesting that VLEM may be a highly specific endoscopic feature of esophagitis in children. This means that if VLEM are observed during an endoscopy, it is likely that the child has esophagitis, and further evaluation and treatment can be tailored accordingly.
